events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Harris County in southeastern Texas...

* WHEN...Until 700 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 539 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Up to 2 inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 2 inches are expected over the
area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Memorial Park, Greater Heights, Neartown / Montrose, Fourth Ward,
Afton Oaks / River Oaks Area, Near Northside Houston, Midtown
Houston, Greenway / Upper Kirby Area, Downtown Houston,
University Place, southeastern Northside / Northline, Lazybrook /
Timbergrove, Independence Heights, Central Northwest, The
Galleria, Museum Park, Spring Branch East and Greater Uptown.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
AQAMEG

The Shelby County Health Department has issued a Code Orange Ozone
Forecast effective for Shelby County Tennessee, Crittenden County
Arkansas, and DeSoto County Mississippi, including the city of
Memphis for today. This ozone forecast is due to forecasted ozone
values that will be unhealthy for sensitive groups. These values will
exceed the Environmental Protection Agency's federal safe health
standard. The Shelby County Health Department recommends that
sensitive groups which include active children and adults, and
people with respiratory disease, such as asthma, limit prolonged
outdoor exertion.

Please continue to check the latest air quality forecasts and updates
until monitored values return to safe levels. For more information go
to www.airnow.gov.

led to valley fog developing and becoming dense early this
morning. Visibilities will be below a quarter of a mile at times

places by 9 am EDT.
